children.name: Eucommia nipponica Ozaki, 1974
children.description: An extinct fossil species of Eucommia (family Eucommiaceae), described by K. Ozaki in 1974 from the Miocene Inkyoyama flora of central Japan (Toki City, Gifu Prefecture). Known from fossil leaves, it documents the formerly much wider range of Eucommia, today a monotypic genus restricted to China with the sole living species E. ulmoides.

children.name: Eucommia ulmoides Oliv.
children.description: Eucommia ulmoides is a species of small tree native to China.
